fields.candidate_bytes: Actual output length; equal completed stream receipt and fresh stat.
fields.candidate_sha256: Fresh completed actual output whole hash; never a capacity estimate.
fields.components: Array in exact source six-component order; each {name,size,blocks,parts}.
fields.components[].parts: Array of {part,size,blocks,row_hex}; row_hex=1024 hexadecimal characters from actual512-byte FAT row.

Root has no continuation, <=240 allocated metadata blocks, exact metadata root flags/name/extent.
All allocation blocks unique, uint16 below65535, in actual EOF; inactive FAT bytes and final component padding zero.
Exact six component names/order; metadata and header allocation changes obey sealed AP8K adapter.
Header allowed byte changes from source are offsets15,24,25,95,96,98,458,459,460,461; output byte15zero; bytes512..4096 unchanged.
Header 9+4 exponents,32 sectors at0x18/0x5f,32768blocks,524288sectors;268435456 bytes explicit declared capacity, not platform maximum.
Lower strides128/126/68 and all descriptor bitfields unchanged; L3stride112/first23 unchanged.
Current lower count*stride significant prefixes retained; current L5 final2padding bits are replaced by actual append start, not byte-concatenated.
Unknown MDR prefix/L2/L1 bytes and nonallocation FAT metadata retained.
